_about: One-line purposes for the Code map, for source files that don't open with a comment saying what they do. build-codemap.mjs uses a file's own opening comment when it has one; a line here wins over it. Keep each to a sentence or two.
import-engine/src/purchaseKey.ts: The purchase key: a SHA-256 of the buyer's email and the purchase time, so the CSV upload and the live sync recognize the same purchase.
import-engine/test/glImport.test.ts: Tests that a prepared import row becomes the shape the database's gl_import() reads, including rows still waiting on a tier mapping.
import-engine/test/guestList.test.ts: Tests for splitting a sponsor's free-text guest list into names, one test per case in the import spec.
import-engine/test/matching.test.ts: Tests for name and organization clean-up and for matching buyers to sponsors and guests to the existing list.
import-engine/test/prepareUpload.test.ts: Tests for the whole CSV upload path: tickets, sponsorships, unclear lists, unmapped tiers and shared inboxes.
import-engine/test/readExport.test.ts: Tests for reading the Give Lively export: columns found by name, missing columns, duplicate purchases.
import-engine/test/tiers.test.ts: Tests for turning a Give Lively tier name into a sponsorship tier, with staff's tier mapping winning.
import-engine/test/values.test.ts: Tests for reading amounts, seat counts and purchase times from export cells.
prototype/checkin-app/src/main.tsx: Starts the iPad check-in app in the browser.
prototype/guest-portal/src/Hero.tsx: The portal's photo slideshow and mission strip (photos wait on AAFE's approval for public use).
prototype/guest-portal/src/Landing.tsx: The portal's front page: explains that sponsors arrive by their private link, and lists demo links for reviews.
prototype/guest-portal/src/Portal.tsx: The sponsor's page behind their private link: their package, their seats, and the form to name each guest.
prototype/guest-portal/src/main.tsx: Starts the sponsor portal in the browser.
prototype/scripts/test-givelively.mts: Tests that Give Lively donations in different shapes become the same normalized row, and which campaigns are imported.
prototype/shared/src/Logo.tsx: AAFE's logo: the orange house mark with the name cycling through English, Spanish, Chinese and Korean.
prototype/shared/src/offlineCheckin.test: Tests for offline check-in at the door: scanned codes, expired codes, who was first, search, and syncing later.
prototype/shared/src/ui.tsx: Pieces every app uses: page routing, display settings (text size, dark mode), the language picker, the prototype banner, dialogs and form fields.
prototype/shared/vite/envGuard.test.ts: Tests that the build guard lets public Supabase settings through and blocks any secret key.
prototype/staff-app/src/components.tsx: Staff app pieces used on several pages: save-once forms, seat status pills, and the payment, pledge and comp guest dialogs.
prototype/staff-app/src/main.tsx: Starts the staff app in the browser.
prototype/staff-app/src/pages/AuditLog.t: The activity log page: every change, with who made it and when.
prototype/staff-app/src/pages/Badges.tsx: The badges page: name badges filled in from the guest list, with table and seat, ready to print or export.
prototype/staff-app/src/pages/CheckIn.ts: The staff app's event-day check-in page: search, mark arrived, and record approved exceptions.
The gala dashboard: what's committed and received, how many seats are named, and who needs follow-up.
prototype/staff-app/src/pages/GalaInfo.t: Gala information: the date, venue and deadlines the portal and emails read from, the run of show, and past galas.
The guest list: every guest in a spreadsheet-like table, editable, with each change logged.
prototype/staff-app/src/pages/Integratio: Integrations and email: the Give Lively import and sync, the Salesforce file, and the email log with drafts waiting for staff approval.
prototype/staff-app/src/pages/Login.tsx: The staff sign-in page: an emailed one-time link when Supabase is set up, demo accounts when it isn't.
prototype/staff-app/src/pages/Payments.t: Payments and fees: what's been received by payment method, and the fee rates used.
prototype/staff-app/src/pages/Relationsh: Relationship guests: the comp guests AAFE's relationship managers invite, and the form to add one.
prototype/staff-app/src/pages/Seating.ts: The seating chart: tables and seats, guests not yet seated, and seating a whole group at once. Staff assign every seat.
prototype/staff-app/src/pages/Sponsors.t: Sponsors and orders: every sponsorship and ticket order, and each one's seats, payments and history.
prototype/staff-app/src/qr.tsx: Draws a QR code image for a guest's e-ticket.
prototype/supabase/functions/_shared/sup: Shared by the edge functions: settings, the server-side Supabase client, web request headers, and who is calling.
